appId.title: GitHub App ID
appId.description: The numeric App ID or Client ID of the GitHub App from the GitHub Developer Settings page.

installationId.title: Installation ID
installationId.description: The GitHub App Installation ID for the target organization or user account.

privateKey.title: RSA Private Key (PEM)
privateKey.description: RSA private key (PEM) generated for the GitHub App. Used to sign short-lived RS256 JWT assertions to mint scoped installation access tokens.

defaultOwner.title: Default Organization / Owner
defaultOwner.description: Optional default GitHub organization or user login (e.g., 'MemberJunction') used when a repository owner is not explicitly provided.

allowedRepositories.title: Allowed Repositories
allowedRepositories.description: Optional comma-separated list of allowed 'owner/repo' or 'owner/*' patterns (e.g., 'MemberJunction/*,BlueCypress/Skip-Client-Open-App'). When set, minted installation tokens are restricted to matching repositories.

allowMerge.title: Allow Pull Request Merge
allowMerge.description: Whether this GitHub App credential is permitted to merge pull requests. Defaults to false so an identity that opens PRs cannot also self-merge them.

defaultPRMode.title: Default Pull Request Mode
defaultPRMode.description: Whether pull requests created using this credential default to 'draft' or 'ready' for review.

apiBaseUrl.title: GitHub API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: GitHub REST API base URL. Defaults to 'https://api.github.com' (use 'https://<hostname>/api/v3' for GitHub Enterprise Server).

webhookSecret.title: Webhook HMAC Secret
webhookSecret.description: Optional GitHub App webhook secret used to verify X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC signatures on inbound webhook events.
